adjudication.rationale: The diff shows poll_feed.rb with `sidekiq_options retry: false` at line 12, and the `poll_feed` method iterates through `rss.items.each` without any try/catch around individual item processing. If any item causes an exception (e.g., malformed content, missing fields like `i.content` being nil when calling `.scrub`), the entire job fails and subsequent items are not processed. With retries disabled, this means those items are permanently skipped until the next hourly poll. This is a real correctness issue - one bad feed item prevents processing of all subsequent items.
